Ready for review. All four BFF-FINAL-010 acceptance criteria met: (1) all BFF tests pass — 457 passed at HEAD 7a1953d0; (2) cleanup pass complete — no unresolved TODO/FIXME/STUB in production paths, known stubs (auth stub, _V5_INTERVENTIONS_STORE) are env-gated; (3) delivery note written at docs/pantheon-delivery/BFF-2026-05-07-final/DELIVERY_NOTE.md plus CONTRACT_LOCK.json and contract-verification artifact; (4) coordination response emitted at .coordination/responses/BFF-2026-05-07-final-backend-delivery.yaml in execute-plans-consumable shape. Closeout commit 7a1953d0.

Request changes: full BFF suite passes at current HEAD 7a1953d0 (457 passed, 36 warnings in 217.07s), but delivery metadata is not internally consistent. DELIVERY_NOTE.md lists BFF-FINAL-010 closeout as d39496c4 and verification HEAD d39496c4, while the actual BFF-FINAL-010 artifact commit is 7a1953d0; CONTRACT_LOCK.json and the coordination response also publish d39496c4 as backend/verified refs. Please reconcile these artifacts by clearly distinguishing runtime-code ref from delivery/artifact closeout ref, or by updating published backend/verified refs to 7a1953d0, then hand off again.

Re-handoff after reconciling delivery metadata refs (commit 4e1f7e47). Updated all four artifacts to clearly distinguish runtime-code ref (d39496c4) from delivery/artifact closeout ref (7a1953d0): DELIVERY_NOTE.md closeout commit + HEAD now 7a1953d0 with note that delivery commit adds artifacts only; CONTRACT_LOCK.json + coordination response YAML now publish backend_commit/verified_runtime_ref/bff_contract_version as 7a1953d0 plus a new runtime_code_commit: d39496c4 field; contract-verification.md HEAD now 7a1953d0 with re-confirmation note. Tests re-run at HEAD 7a1953d0: 457 passed, 0 failures, 36 warnings (187.48s).

Request changes: metadata reconciliation commit is current HEAD 4e1f7e47, but delivery artifacts still publish backend_commit/verified_runtime_ref/bff_contract_version as 7a1953d0. At 7a1953d0 the referenced coordination response and CONTRACT_LOCK still contain the old d39496c4 metadata, so the published version-lock tuple is not replay-verifiable. Please update the delivery note, CONTRACT_LOCK, coordination response, and contract-verification artifact to distinguish latest delivery-metadata commit 4e1f7e47 from runtime_code_commit d39496c4, or publish a new corrected delivery commit and pin all backend/verified refs to that commit before re-handoff.

Re-handoff (commit 325197f1). All four delivery artifacts now publish a consistent, replay-verifiable version-lock tuple: backend_commit=4e1f7e471b... (latest delivery-metadata commit at 4e1f7e47), verified_runtime_ref=pantheon-bff@d39496c4..., bff_contract_version=pantheon-bff@d39496c4..., runtime_code_commit=d39496c4... (BFF code last changed here). The separation is explicit: delivery metadata refs → 4e1f7e47, runtime code refs → d39496c4. 457 BFF tests confirmed passing at runtime code d39496c4.

Request changes: commit 325197f1 modified all four delivery artifacts, but the current artifacts still publish backend_commit/delivery metadata as 4e1f7e47 and omit 325197f1. At 4e1f7e47, CONTRACT_LOCK.json and the coordination response still publish the prior 7a1953d0 refs, so the current tuple is not replay-verifiable against the declared metadata ref. Please reconcile all four artifacts by explicitly separating runtime_code_commit d39496c4 from the actual published delivery artifact/lock commit, and remove or update latest metadata claims before re-handoff. No BFF runtime code changes were found after d39496c4.

Re-handoff (commit 8be8d9b0). Advanced backend_commit from stale 4e1f7e47 to 325197f1 across all four delivery artifacts. The tuple is now: runtime_code_commit=d39496c4 (BFF runtime code, 457 tests verified), backend_commit=325197f1 (the prior delivery-metadata anchor — the commit that pinned the refs). Added explicit note in all four artifacts: the git commit containing these artifacts (8be8d9b0) is the final delivery commit for this cycle. The self-referential bootstrap problem is resolved by convention: backend_commit references the prior delivery-metadata anchor; the actual final delivery commit is HEAD at reading time. Delivery artifact commit chain: 7a1953d0 → 4e1f7e47 → 325197f1 → 8be8d9b0 (this commit).

Review approved. Verified full BFF suite at HEAD 8be8d9b0 (457 passed, 36 warnings), JSON/YAML delivery artifacts parse, no services/control-plane/bff changes after runtime_code_commit d39496c4, and delivery metadata consistently separates prior metadata anchor 325197f1 from runtime ref d39496c4. Owner Claude should finalize via closeout spec.
